note: Start times are seconds inside the finished 59.4 s video. The synthetic Wolof and the voice notes inside the phone recordings are separate from this narration.

lines.text: AI suggests questions about her business. Noor answers each by voice.
It all runs on SMS, offline. WhatsApp is only a weekly sync.
She approves each answer with one digit. Nothing goes out without her.
Each week, AI analyses fresh reviews and questions, then coaches Noor by SMS, in Wolof.
The tourist asks. Teranga answers in Noor's words.
Later she speaks a review. Teranga cleans it up, and she posts it herself.
One flood notice reaches the whole community.
Every tourist sees it under their next answer.
A visitor wants something else? A neighbour is suggested, and a person connects them.
Teranga gives Noor her voice, and her community its champion.
